turns.question: How many satellite detections and what summed FRP in MW are recorded here? Are these separate fires?

request.user_question: How many satellite detections and what summed FRP in MW are recorded here? Are these separate fires?

response.explanation_markdown:
**119 satellite detections** for 2021-08-14 to 2021-08-22. These are thermal observations, not a count of distinct fire incidents. [5]

**Total summed FRP for the selected period: 3,328.57 MW**. [5]

This sums instantaneous FRP samples across the accepted detections in the selected area and dates. It is not a daily peak, simultaneous fire power or time-integrated energy.

citations.title: NASA FIRMS active fire observations
citations.relevance_note: Local accepted, deduplicated detection centers; detections are not distinct fires. FRP is power in MW, not energy or burned area.
